Headings beside the scrollbar, and a quieter list of the files that name a page.

**Headings beside the scrollbar.**
- While a Markdown page scrolls, its headings come up as pills beside the scrollbar, each at the height that heading stands at in the page, so the thumb lies over the ones on screen. The size of a pill's text follows the heading's level. They slide in, and fade out a moment after the scrolling stops; they stay while the pointer is on one or the thumb is held.
- The pill of the section being read is outlined, and a click on a pill scrolls to its heading.
- No two pills overlap: a higher heading keeps its place, a lower one is moved a little out of its way, keeping the page's order, and is left out only when there is no room near its place.
- New options: which heading levels are shown, H1 to H6 (`#`, `##` and `###` by default; none turns the pills off); how long they stay after the scrolling stops, 1200 ms by default; and how far the page must scroll in one go before they come up, any distance by default. Opening a file, which puts it back where it was read, brings none up.

**Referenced by.**
- The "Referenced by N files" line is gone. The list is marked instead by a bar of the link colour down its left and a faint wash of it behind, with no frame around it.

Install: download `docs-panel-0.12.0.vsix` below, then run `code --install-extension docs-panel-0.12.0.vsix`.
